title: La Real Academia Española (RAE) y las Academias de la Lengua (ASALE)
goal: Understand the role of the Real Academia Española (founded in Madrid in 1713) and the Association of Academies of the Spanish Language (ASALE, 23 academies across the world) in maintaining the pan-Hispanic unity of the Spanish language.
grammar: Using 'velar por que los cambios no quiebren la unidad del idioma' and 'en colaboración con las academias hermanas'.

items: Understand the role of the Real Academia Española (founded in Madrid in 1713) and the Association of Academies of the Spanish Language (ASALE, 23 academies across the world) in maintaining the pan-Hispanic unity of the Spanish language.
